From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@orion-analytics.com>

Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding / PO info needed

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the intro — we're excited to get Redwood on the vendor list. Attached is our completed onboarding form and the initial catalog of services we'll be consuming. A couple of questions from our finance team:

- Can Redwood issue a single PO number per quarter for us, or do you need a PO per line item?
- We have three cost centers we need to charge against (ENG-Cloud, DATA-Research, PROD-Analytics). Is it possible to split a single invoice across multiple cost centers / PO line-items?

Also, what spend cap controls can you enforce at the PO or contract level? Our finance team requires a hard monthly spend cap per cost center.

Attachments: orion_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf), initial_catalog.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Sophie Lang
Head of Procurement
Orion Analytics
phone: +1 415-555-0198

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@orion-analytics.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-15T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / PO info needed

Hi Sophie — welcome, and thanks for the form. Looping in Monica (procurement ops) to handle PO routing and cost-center mapping. Quick answers up front:

- We can issue a single PO number and map multiple invoice line-items to internal cost centers.
- We support per-PO and per-line hard spend caps via our billing config; we need the specific cap per cost center to lock it down.
- For split invoices, we typically create separate line items in the PO mapping table and assign each a cost-center code.

Monica — can you take point on generating the PO mapping CSV and confirm process/timeline? Sophie, if you can provide the monthly cap amounts per cost center and the billing contact we’ll draft the PO and routing table.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
--

Hi Sophie, Jordan — thanks. I prepared a draft PO_mapping_table.csv and attached a worked example showing how we'll split the line items across your three cost centers. Key notes:

- PO format: one PO number issued to Orion Analytics (PO-2026-OR-1173), with 3 distinct invoice line-items mapped to cost-center codes ENG-CLD / DATA-RSRCH / PROD-ANL.
- Spend caps: we can enforce a monthly hard cap per line item. Please confirm the cap amounts for each cost center.
- Line-item corrections: If the contracted SKU changes after PO issuance, submit the "PO line adjustment" form and we'll issue an amended PO. Small corrections (<$500) can be handled on the next invoice instead of amending.
- Timing: Once caps and billing contact are confirmed, we can issue the PO within 48 business hours.
